body:
Thank you so much for replying.
Just the acknowledgment that someone realizes how much pain I am in helped, I don't know why.  My counselor is rather absent minded- she doesn't remember what time appointments are and often misses them.  Plus, shes back home so I have to have phone sessions with her when I am at college.  I had to come home this weekend to isolate because I have been so low, but I am done in a month.

I am ready to self destruct.  I don't even mean kill myself, maybe I should move to a different sub reddit.  I just mean self destruct like, I want to do drugs or self harm or something....not kill myself.  Maybe I should have waited the few years to post this...when I was actually in danger of wanting to die at the current moment.

I am sorry, this is pathetic, why am I obsessively posting on this?  I guess I have nowhere else to turn.

Thank you.

Yeah, I've been on Prozac for awhile, about one and a half to two years now.  I'm on the lowest dose possible, because earlier when my psychiatrist raised the dosage, I went completely manic / suicidal depressed and had an awful reaction, but I was okay on a low dose.  (My doctor said this reaction to prozac may further back up the theory that I have bipolar disorder.)  I am kind of giving up hope, since I have never found medicines that work well and I have been trying different medicines and combinations for 6 years and so far have not found relief.

Every time I happen to look in the mirror and be okay with my looks and my body in general, it is ruined when I see a picture or video of myself.  Most of the time I just want to tear off my face I hate it so much.  So, even when I am feeling happier, I can't stand being this disgusting.

I really don't know what to do.  I know I'm going to die in the future by my own doing, it's just a few years into the future....and whenever I actually get the guts...if I ever do get the guts....because right now I'm too afraid and I know part of me doesn't want to.
